<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the carbonyl‑ene reaction (breaks a hydroxyl, forms a ketone, changes a C=O to single bond and a C=C to single bond). This will give a template ID we can use for the single‑step route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["hydroxyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O","C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}
